messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
The “top‑ranked” spot in tennis is always changing with each new ranking release, but as of the most recent ATP and WTA updates:

| Category | Current No. 1 (as of the latest ranking release) |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| **Men’s singles (ATP)** | **Novak Djokovic** (Serbia) |
| **Women’s singles (WTA)** | **Iga Świątek** (Poland) |

These players have held the top spot for the longest stretches in the past few years, and they’re still at the pinnacle of the sport according to the latest official rankings. If you need the exact date of the ranking or want to see the full list, you can check the ATP/WTA websites or the official ranking PDFs.
